contacts.faq_1_q: How do I register as a Master?
contacts.faq_1_a: Click "Register", choose the "Master" role, complete your profile information, and start accepting requests.
contacts.faq_2_a: Registration and profile creation are free. A commission fee on successful transactions may be applied in the future.
contacts.faq_3_q: How do I report a problem with a Master?
contacts.faq_3_a: Open the Master's profile and click "Report a problem", or write to info{'@'}meistari.lv.
contacts.faq_4_a: Yes — in Profile Settings under "Account management" you'll find the account deletion option.
contacts.faq_5_q: How long does a profile stay active?
contacts.faq_5_a: Your profile stays active until the account is deleted or deactivated.
